image_description: A male mallard duck (drake) resting on grass in front of a textured stone wall. The duck displays characteristic breeding plumage with an iridescent green head, white neck ring, chestnut breast, and grey-brown body. The bill is yellow-green with a dark tip. The bird is in a tucked, resting posture with legs hidden beneath the body.
